title: Chapter 826
text:
After killing Atimo, the [Destroy the Great Cosmos Corps] mission did not end immediately. There were still other players chasing after the fish that escaped to other places.

After the battle ended, the hundreds of thousands of players on the battlefield checked their interfaces, and quite a few of them saw a notification that only popped up during the battle.

Black Star Corps submitted [Great Cosmos Corps Exploration Information]!

[Flickering World: First Round] rating increased by one small grade!

The Flickering World Main Storyline Mission had a similar rating, and not only did Han Xiao receive this notification, the other players also received it and were overjoyed.

The army was helping them expand the rewards of the battle.

The players present were overjoyed. After this mission ended, the Exploration Points accumulated by all the players would probably be able to raise the rating of the first round of the Main Storyline Mission from D to C.

Other than the players, there were no other living beings on the battlefield. The players scattered across the battlefield and entered the wreckage of the enemy battleships to search for loot. Although the technological level of the Great Cosmos Corps was far inferior to the Black Star Corps, the players never left empty-handed and swept through everything of value like locusts.

After looting the corpses for a while, the hundreds of thousands of players left in their spaceships.

This crater was filled with burn marks, and there were huge craters everywhere. Wreckage of battleships was stabbed into the ground, and black smoke billowed. Spaceships carrying players rose into the sky and left the planet. They waved their hands and left the planet, leaving behind only the ruins of the battle and the corpses that no one cared about.

…

On the forums, many of the players who had participated in killing Atimo started to boast about the First Blood. As the first Calamity Grade Super that they had killed, Atimo was extremely memorable, and someone immediately recorded this event in the Shattered Star Ring's Chronicles. In Galaxy Calendar Year 705, Atimo's First Blood was completed.

Of course, there were some who were proud. It had already been three versions, and everyone had seen a Calamity Grade for the first time in Version 2.0. During the secret war in Version 3.0, they had personally participated in a battlefield with a Calamity Grade. The strength of a Calamity Grade was deeply ingrained in their hearts, and they had finally killed one.

Although they were surrounded by hundreds of thousands of people, and the other party was a native, and they had relied on the army to prevent the other party from escaping, the players were still very excited.

Someone had analyzed a long time ago that as long as the combat power system did not change, as the upper limit of the level would continue to increase, their importance in the galaxy would also increase. This First Clear was the new evidence for this theory.

Many players couldn't help but look forward to the future versions.

Maybe one day, we can punch Heber and kick Sisko?

It was a pity that Han Xiao did not know about the ambitions of these players. Otherwise, he would have let them continue to sleep and dream about everything.

Dynasty was the one who took the kill reward. As one of China's oldest clubs, no one was surprised that they took Atimo's first kill. In reality, no matter which of the Four Great Guilds obtained the kill, it would be normal in their eyes. If any other Guild or even an ordinary player obtained the kill, they would be considered lucky.

Many players were envious when they saw the kill rewards and mission rewards posted by Dynasty's official platform. The ones who were envious the most were the other guilds.

This was the First Kill of a Calamity Grade Super Boss they were talking about. The rewards were secondary. The fame that came from the First Kill was what the various large guilds wanted. This was the glory of the guild and could be used to attract members. Even if they defeated a new Calamity Grade Boss in the future, it would not be as significant as the First Kill.

Second Prince was very pleased with himself and posted a screenshot of the moment of the kill. He was the one who dealt the final blow, and he could not help but brag about it on the forums, causing everyone to be envious.

Although he was a pro player, he had never paid attention to building his image. As the second in the Dynasty team, he had always wanted to rise above King Admiral and gave people the impression that he was both mischievous and arrogant.

However, as Maple Moon revealed her mission under Frenzied Sword's instigation, all of the players' attention was drawn away from Second Prince.

The screenshot that Maple Moon posted included her discovery of the beacon and her independent mission as the instigator of this incident.

Many players originally thought that the Black Star Corps attacking the Great Cosmos Corps was ordered by the dynasty. However, after seeing Maple Moon's screenshot, they were shocked to realize that the army's large-scale attack this time was actually a storyline created by a player!

This seemed to be the first time that a player had such a huge impact on the army!

"Oh my god, this was actually a hidden mission triggered by a player?"

"Maple Moon? This name sounds familiar … Aren't they the four people who followed the Army Commander in the earliest version? "

"To be able to discover such a good hidden mission, they are really lucky."

Many players were envious of Maple Moon again. In the past two versions, Maple Moon had not revealed herself, but she had suddenly become famous.

In Han Xiao's previous life, Maple Moon was already famous for discovering hidden storylines, and she gradually became famous in Version 3.0, becoming a dark horse in the third Galaxy Pro League. This was not strange at all. There were dark horses every year, and there were especially many in the third Galaxy Pro League. Because Version 3.0 was the rise of the Mechanic class, eighty percent of the dark horses were Mechanic players who had very embarrassing results in the previous two Galaxy Pro Leagues.

The reward for her solo mission this time was extremely generous, and it was even more than killing Atimo. This made the spectators on the forums green with envy. She did not even need to kill the BOSS, and she only needed to slack by the side to obtain more rewards than killing the BOSS? That was too profitable!

Second Prince immediately became listless. He stopped showing off and joined the envious crowd. Compared to the other professional players who were cold and aloof, he was much more active. He liked to mingle with the crowd … in various senses of the word.

These were not the only screenshots of Maple Moon. There were also the rewards that Black Star had given her through the faction interface.

You have triggered the faction mission [Black Star's Generosity]!

Mission Completed!

Due to your contribution, your faction [Black Star Corps] has received an Exploration Achievement.

Black Star's favorability toward you has increased by 10 points.

You have received 25,000,000 EXP, 200,000 Enas, and 2,000 Black Star Corps Contribution Points.

Your army rank has increased by one.

You have received a new army title — [Merit Explorer].

Looking at the rewards given to Maple Moon by the army, countless spectators were drooling.

Oh my god, the army's reward was even better. 200,000 Enas was not a small amount, and there was even an independent army title. The effects of this title were way too tempting. You could receive 500 Enas every day, 15,000 Enas a month, and 180,000 Enas a year. The long-term benefits were very impressive. Furthermore, you could receive money while sitting at home!

They had always been the ones spending money in the army. This was the first time they had seen someone receiving money from the army.

The meaning of Han Xiao's mission was very clear. Did you see that? This is the treatment of a meritorious person!

[Secret Explorer] and [Merit Explorer] were both army titles, but [Secret Explorer] and [Merit Explorer] were different. The former was given to all the players who participated in the secret war, while the latter was a unique title that only Maple Moon and Scorpion Daddy had.

This also confirmed one of their guesses. As long as the method was right, the players could also indirectly influence the actions of a faction. Many people became excited.

Through Maple Moon's screenshot, the players understood how to replicate this incident. The only way was to find hidden missions and hand them over to the army!

"Now that the army is exploring the Flickering World, as long as we can find hidden elements similar to the Great Cosmos Corps, we can also get the [Merit Explorer] title, right?"

"That's definitely the case. The army has such an achievement title to encourage the members to carefully dig for hidden clues!"

With Maple Moon as an example, countless players were stimulated, and their passion for hidden missions was ignited. They could not wait to immediately explore the planet and dig three feet into the ground to find hidden missions.

…

Looking at the red-eyed spectators on the forums, Han Xiaoxin was secretly overjoyed and chuckled.

He had given Maple Moon a title alone, which had both glory and benefits. This was to encourage the other players to find hidden missions and hand them over to him.

After all, finding hidden missions was the specialty of the players with the interface. Perhaps his second [Bold Explorer] fragment would fall into the hands of these players.

Other than that, he also had the intention of grooming Maple Moon. In his previous life, this lady was one of the representatives of the rise of the Mechanic class in Version 3.0. As a Great Teacher of the Mechanic class, if the overall results of the Mechanic class were better in this Pro League, he would be able to trick … ahem, attract more new players to choose the Mechanic class, and he would have more high-quality leeks to harvest.

Maple Moon was a dark horse in this Pro League, and Han Xiao did not mind making this dark horse even darker. With so many rewards, Maple Moon would probably be the first player to reach the max level.

The players were still chasing after the remnants of the Great Cosmos Corps. They would then go and take over the other party's territory according to the information, so there would not be any problems. Han Xiao stopped paying attention and let the players do as they pleased.

Looking around, other than the operators, there were only two officers in the room, Aurora and Fu Ding.

Aurora was sitting in front of the control panel, her head drooping as if she was about to fall asleep. She did not need to manage the autopilot, so she was already dozing off. On the other side, Fu Ding was sitting on the sofa, resting with his eyes closed. It was unknown if he was training his psychic energy or chatting with Chen Xing in his mind.

The other Black Star Guards, under the leadership of Hella, spent all day fighting in the combat training room. The exploration had already been going on for more than a month, and after the initial novelty, they no longer paid attention to the exploration progress. Hella could not stand standing beside Han Xiao and slacking with him every day, so she dragged the other Black Star Guards into training mode every day.

"A motivated career woman is still quite charming." Han Xiao shook his head, entered the quantum network, and contacted Blue Star.

The Black Star Corps' quantum network base station in the Dawn Star Cluster had already been built, and he could already contact the people in the Shattered Star Ring through the army's internal communication channel. He did not need to go through the Red Empire as an intermediary.

Floating Dragon had already settled down in Blue Star for more than a month, so he contacted Blue Star mainly to ask about the situation on Floating Dragon Island.

It didn't take long for Bennett to come online. After not contacting him for a while, Bennett's voice sounded high-spirited and full of motivation.

Bennett reported the situation. In the past month, Floating Dragon had started to expand, and a large number of people and financial groups had come. Blue Star was affected by this and welcomed a new development opportunity.

With the current speed of Blue Star's development, Bennett felt that he could bring forward the alien colonization plan that he had only planned to propose a few decades later. For a surface civilization, this was not easy, but with the help of so many galactic organizations, colonizing an alien planet was much easier than slowly climbing the technology tree.

With the protection of Floating Dragon, the safety of the alien colonization was guaranteed. Bennett planned to use five years to digest the benefits that Floating Dragon Island had brought him before officially starting Blue Star's alien colonization plan. He called it the Five Year Plan … Han Xiao could not help but tremble when he heard it.

After reporting the development of Blue Star, Bennett brought up another matter.

"About the Star Pupil Protoss militants who tried to attack Blue Star more than a month ago, I have already prepared the materials and evidence. I plan to bring it up in the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference and condemn the Star Pupil Protoss …"

"Not bad. Since you have this identity, you should make good use of it." Han Xiao nodded. Sisko's people had done something wrong, so there was nothing wrong with letting him take the blame.

"I will attend the conference through remote projection. Black Star, is it convenient for you to attend the conference through remote projection as well?" Bennett wanted to find someone to hold the fort. After all, Sisko was a Beyond Grade A, and he felt that he was not qualified. Since Black Star was the representative of Blue Star, it was normal for them to attend the conference together.

"Me? Haha, of course it's convenient for me. I've been very free recently. "Han Xiao chuckled.

Attending the conference personally was not a bad idea. He could see Sisko's pained expression … Hmm, he did not seem to have such an organ.
